exposure: Women with strong exclusive breastfeeding intentions
outcome: Exclusive breastfeeding cessation at 3 months postpartum
cohort: 210 pregnant women residing in suburban parts of the Federal Capital Territory, Abuja, Nigeria
finding: Prenatal exclusive breastfeeding intention was a strong predictor of exclusive breastfeeding at 3 months postpartum.
mod_finding: The risk of exclusive breastfeeding cessation was significantly lower in women with vaginal deliveries.
